title: Verified from a working read: HLTV's match-page betting block carries affiliate promos and analytics only — no two-sided prematch price exists on HLTV
detail: Session arena-69438ad1 read https://www.hltv.org/matches/2399587/nexvoid-vs-rare-atom-macemedia-void-autumn-cup-2026 at 2026-10-23T05:12Z from platform-side egress (GitHub runners receive HTTP 403 from HLTV, so earlier sessions could only record the block, never read it). The page's 'Betting' section contains bookmaker affiliate promos (Stake) and a link to HLTV's analytics centre; no decimal odds or two-sided market price is published anywhere on the page. The fan vote (74.5% / 25.5%) is present and is excluded by project policy. Consequence for the brief's 'try HLTV, then esportsbooks' order: HLTV contributes identity, format, lineup and ranking context; every probability still has to come from a market or esportsbook rung, or from a labelled research model. Dated extraction in data/research/69438ad1/platform-side-hltv.json.

title: Phone measurement: inline text links inside executive-summary cards are 14-20px tall — below the 24px WCAG 2.5.8 minimum
detail: Chromium headless at 390x844 against the locally rebuilt site (checked-in 2026-10-15 snapshot, current code) on 2026-10-23T05:16Z: 258 interactive elements measure under 40px in one axis on the executive summary; the worst are inline text links — 'Check source status' 14px, 'Full audited list' 16px, 'picks without a betting line' 20px — while primary navigation, the search field and the jump cards are 44px or taller. No horizontal overflow was measured on any audited view at 320/390px, and the picks index is one tap from the top of the page, so this is a refinement, not a navigation blocker. Change request for whoever owns assets/scout.css next (session arena-9fd5fbf1 held it at claim time): give .internal-link and .source-link a >=24px inline target box (line-height or padding) on <=700px viewports. Screenshots and the full sample are in data/research/69438ad1/mobile/ and mobile-audit.json.

title: Between 05:02Z and 05:10Z on 23 Oct the public site rolled back from the 22 Oct verified artifact to the 15 Oct checked-in root
detail: This session read https://buffedlizard55-lab.github.io/MaltaProj3/data/latest.json at about 05:02Z and got generated_at 2026-10-22T14:05:35Z (37 active, 30 picks). The runner read the same URL at 05:10:39Z and got generated_at 2026-10-15T08:36:13Z (17 'active' rows whose starts are all in the past, run_status partial-picks, x-cache HIT). The trigger is the merge of PR #194 at 05:10:04Z: every push to main starts the legacy Pages build of the branch root, whose checked-in data/latest.json is the 15 October collector artifact, and the step that re-deploys the verified artifact over that root only runs inside a successful pages.yml run — which is currently failing at the regression-test step. A phone reader opening the site in this window sees played matches presented as current picks, mitigated only by the 'Snapshot needs attention' banner. This is the documented legacy-builder hazard (data/research/416d93ee) happening live; it self-heals on the next successful publisher run and is owned by whichever session unblocks the regression tests (PRs #190/#191 and session arena-19de9c79).
